breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=2.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 2].
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the final time to T=2.0 to match the specified domain t in [0, 2.0]. The Agent, however, explicitly acknowledges the conflict ('The time domain is t in [0, 2.0], but compute the final solution at T = 2.1.') and then proceeds to use the incorrect final time T=2.1 for all calculations, thereby failing to fix the error.
